title: Restore UTF-16 counting at the AskUserQuestion header guard; fix the inverted code_unit_cmp rationale
action: Two judge findings against jp-5. FIX 1 (behavior): hooks/write_guard/detectors.rs:156 was converted from utf16_len(h)>12 to char_len(h)>12, but the paired validator is EXTERNAL and JS — Claude Code's AskUserQuestion header limit counts String.length = UTF-16 code units (skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md:50, decision 3156acf1). A 7-astral-char header (14 code units) now passes bee's guard but violates the tool's limit. Add a utf16_len (code-unit length) helper to crates/bee/src/textutil.rs with a doc comment naming the external JS validator as its reason, and use it at detectors.rs:156. Do NOT convert any other site. FIX 2 (docs, dangerous-if-wrong): the D3-exception rationale is factually inverted — release-manifest paths are sorted by sort_by_locale (localeCompare), NOT code_unit_cmp; the real byte-reproduction constraints on code_unit_cmp are devtools/skill_trees.rs:331-341 manifest_fingerprint feeding sha256 sidecar digests (also :356,:424) and release_manifest.rs:468,474 diff.missing/diff.added ordering (locked by test changed_uses_locale_order_while_missing_uses_code_units). Rewrite textutil.rs:17-27 and devtools/mod.rs:274-276 to name those real constraints. Also append a one-line correction note to docs/history/js-parity-cleanup/CONTEXT.md under the evidence bullet (do not rewrite the original line; add 'CORRECTION (jp-9): ...'). Both fixes cite the judge pass in the commit body.
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml green from the worktree; detectors.rs header threshold counts UTF-16 code units; textutil/devtools rationale names skill_trees digests not manifest sort

truths: detectors.rs:156 counts UTF-16 code units again via a textutil helper whose comment names the external JS validator
textutil.rs and devtools/mod.rs rationale states the real constraint (skill_trees sidecar digests + diff report order), not the manifest path sort
CONTEXT.md carries an explicit CORRECTION note; full suite green

trace.outcome: Fixed inverted AskUserQuestion header guard (utf16_len restored) and corrected the code_unit_cmp EXCEPTION rationale (skill_trees digests + diff report, not manifest path sort); worktree cargo test --release: 1006 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored (plus 9/13/5/10/11/2/9/10/3/5/8/2 across integration suites, all green)
